title: Real Madrid’s Kylian Mbappe out of Clasico vs. Barcelona with hamstring injury
content:
Kylian Mbappe is out of Real Madrid’s El Clasico at Barcelona after not recovering from a hamstring injury.

Mbappe, 27, has not featured since being forced off with the muscular injury during Madrid’s La Liga draw with Real Betis on April 24 and missed last week’s win over Espanyol.

It was subsequently confirmed the forward had sustained a left hamstring strain and The Athletic reported he was targeting a return against Barcelona on May 10.

Alvaro Arbeloa said after the win at Espanyol last Sunday, however, that “it might take a bit longer” and “we’ll see how Mbappe is this week”.

The Madrid head coach did not address questions on Mbappe’s fitness at his pre-match press conference on Saturday and the France international striker has not returned in time for the clash.

Barcelona can win the La Liga title if they avoid defeat against rivals Madrid at Camp Nou today — it would mark the first time in La Liga history the league title has been decided in the Clasico.

If Madrid win, however, they will reduce the gap at the top to eight points with three league matches remaining, and Barca could instead secure the title against Alaves the following Wednesday.

Mbappe has scored 41 goals in 41 appearances across all competitions this season, either side of a series of short-term spells out with a left knee injury.

Madrid have a host of absentees for the match including Fede Valverde, Rodrygo, Eder Militao, Arda Guler, Dani Carvajal and Ferland Mendy.

Madrid were 2-1 winners during October’s reverse fixture at the Bernabeu.
